notes.title: PErformance Update
notes.notes:
Performance Update:

We have worked on your reports about the game performance, so we have launched a new game update in order to give you the best gaming experience possible in the game.

notes.title: The Hero OST is Now Available
notes.notes:
"The Hero OST" is the original soundtrack created for the game title "The Hero"

It contains all of tracks included within the game in ".MP3" extension of the game original sound track.

It contains 12 tracks with total play time of 30 minutes.

TRACK LISTING

1-Break Out

2-Dark Around Us

3-Emotional Track

4-Journey

5-Look out

6-Main Theme

7-Nothing To Lose

8-One More

9-Strings Attached

10-Suspenseful Move

11-Tension Begins

12-What Around There

notes.title: Update 3 Is now Available
notes.notes:
Update 3 is now Available.

In this update, we have fixed all of the reported performance issues found within the game, especially those in the open map areas. 

In addition, We also Fixed reported aiming issues in the game for better gaming experience.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update 2 is now Available
notes.notes:
Update 2 is now Available

This update contains the following:

Improving game performance.

Fixing weird sound when spawning.

Fixing floating weapons on character.

Fixing weird character and weapon appearing sometimes after death.

Fixing crosshair problems after cover.

Fixing elevator in Fire station map.

Fixing some assets collisions.

Thank you for your support.
